_comment: npuserv registry.  One entry per model that can go on the ZG330.
'root' is where the 'adapter' paths hang off, relative to this file: '..' resolves to
lang/ (the server lives in lang/npuserv, the 件 live under lang/llm/models/).
Any 件 can be registered that way -- the mechanics in npuserv know nothing about
tokens; model-specific steps stay in the model's own directory as npuserv_adapter.py.
'defaults' is merged under the params of a POST /load; 'env' is set before the
worker is spawned.  No credentials in this file (D-27: a secret value is written
Two path conventions live here and they are not the same kind of fact:
'adapter' is RELATIVE to 'root' and must resolve in BOTH trees -- on the PC it
lands on the submodule checkout, on 113 it lands on the mirrored tree, so the
'Board layout').  tests/lifecycle_check.py asserts every entry resolves.
'artifacts' and the paths inside 'env' are BOARD-absolute (the server runs on
113); on a PC GET /models will honestly report artifacts_present:false.
'compiled_with' is the iCraft version that produced the 件, recorded because the
board runtime has to match it -- it is a declaration, NOT a check: nothing here
verifies it, and a mismatch shows up as a worker that dies on import.

models.compiled_with: icraft 3.39.0 (ZG codegen; the compile tree under agentwork/ernie/compile logs that version)

capabilities.reason_text: board-side via board/e41_tok.py (pure stdlib, reads the prebuilt e41_tok.pack; no tokenizers). PC: verified id-for-id and string-for-string equal to tokenizers 0.23.3 over 219,085 comparisons (scripts/tok_parity.py, 0 mismatches). Board: the module loads and encodes on 3.8.10 (11-04, re-run 11-06 -- pack md5 4f197a7481e445cff008593053ec82b4, id_space 101304 / vocab 100295 / merges 182926, encode('你好')==[5300]); NO generate has run on the board yet. The npuserv adapter applies NO chat template: text_in encodes raw text, text_out decodes the generated ids.

models.note: 现役产品链那一颗（台账 #241 同一条路的常驻件）；KV 窗口编死 NS=512 ⇒ 上限 511 槽（e41_chatd.py:61）。窄读是 daemon 里的现役写法，不是旋钮（info.read 报告它）。apply ≈50-95 s。e41_chatd.py 里 JSON_/RAW_ 的**出厂默认值仍是 /mnt/data/ernie/...**，而那个目录板上现场复核已经不存在（`ls: cannot access '/mnt/data/ernie'`），所以上面 env 那两行是承重的、不是可选——实测：不带 env 直接 import 时 os.path.exists 两个都 False。

models.compiled_with: icraft 3.39.0 (只在该仓 compile 目录里命中一次，证据比 ERNIE 那颗薄，标 B)

capabilities.reason_text: text paths call tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file on the board and have NEVER been executed -- neither generation nor this tokenizer file's loadability is proven (#210 vs #220). Send ids and pass decode:false until the board says otherwise. 注意这颗与 ernie 的 text_in 不是同一种依赖：ernie 自带板侧纯 stdlib 分词（e41_tok.py＋pack，板上 load/encode 已实测），这颗赌的是板端 tokenizers 库能不能读那颗 json——第三颗进来时这条差别必须在 registry 里看得出来。

models.note: 件在板上叫 Q3V1-、库里叫 Q3I-（同一张图，台账 #208）；库里 board/tokenizer.json 与板上那颗不同一份，分词一律以板上 #210 为准。四档预检到 apply 全过，生成从未跑过 ⇒ 这条 adapter 是写好未验证的状态，而且它依赖的 patch/q3_infer_board.py 也从没上过板（#208-#211 那次 push 只有 json/raw/tokenizer 三份）。点火要推三件：npuserv/、这颗 adapter、q3_infer_board.py。pos_rule=vendor 逐字复现厂商 run_prompt＋run_decode 两条循环（Qwen2 出通顺中文用的就是这套位置口径）；uniform 是消融档。

models.compiled_with: n/a -- fixture, no 件 and no icraft

capabilities.reason_text: no NPU, no icraft: replays ids and sleeps load_ms/step_ms so the server, the protocol and the lifecycle get tested on a PC

models.note: test fixture only.  Load this to exercise /load /generate /unload and the one-slot rules.
